_comment: Mode configuration. Values marked PROPOSAL are prototype defaults (design/decision-register.md), not confirmed rules. CONFIRMED values come from the user.
rewards_note: CONFIRMED C-02: each player picks 4 rewards after every game, any combination of add/remove/change basic type.
reward_add_offer_note: PROPOSAL: an add-card reward offers 3 random cards; pick one.
first_player_rule: CONFIRMED C-01: loser of the previous game chooses who goes first. PROPOSAL P-01: game 1 coin flip.
basic_change_note: PROPOSAL: changing a basic unit's type changes every copy of that basic unit in the deck.

draft._note: PROPOSAL P-03: category draft, pick 1 of `offer` each time.

steam_app_id_note: 480 = Valve Spacewar test app (development only). Replace with the real App ID.
